Is my wallet address safe here?
Yes. The code is generated entirely in your browser — your address is never uploaded or stored anywhere. For extra safety, verify the code decodes to your address before sharing it.
Do I have to set an amount?
No. Leave it blank and the payer enters the amount in their wallet. Setting it is handy for fixed prices.
Which wallets can scan it?
Any wallet that supports BIP-21 payment URIs — that's virtually all of them. The code opens the wallet with your address pre-filled.
Can someone change where the money goes?
Only if they make their own code. Always generate the code yourself and verify it decodes to your address — never trust a payment code someone else made for you.
